capabilities: Publish notes to a selected WeChat Official Account draft box
Edit visual themes with live style adjustments
Generate article illustrations from prompt comments
Crop cover images to a fixed 2.35:1 frame
extras: Copying formatted content works without account setup; publishing needs WeChat API permissions. Credentials stored in data.json; image cache holds up to 2000 entries for 90 days. Each publish targets one account; no broadcasting to subscribers.
problem: Obsidian cannot style Markdown for WeChat or send notes to WeChat Official Account drafts, so authors must reformat articles in the WeChat editor.

relations.evidence: copy the article to the WeChat editor or send it to the draft box
Generate illustrations from image-prompt comments, edit prompts, track progress, and regenerate results

requires.name: WeChat Official Account (App ID and App secret)

summary: WeChat publishing plugin that formats, previews, styles, and sends Obsidian Markdown notes as drafts to WeChat Official Accounts.
